# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## Why **Responsible Manufacturers** Rely on Acme-Hardesty for High-Quality Sustainable Ingredients

At Acme-Hardesty, our word is our bond. We **[prioritize sustainability][33]** in the bio-based
chemical sourcing industry and provide renewable, sustainable alternatives for manufacturers.

Acme-Hardesty understands **[relationships matter][34]**, and no one in this business does it alone.
Our relationships are built on trust, innovation and sustainable performance. We call upon our
deeply valued relationships to meet the needs of suppliers and customers as well as provide a
dependable, cost-effective flow of quality products from source to end user.

## Our Suite of Bio-Based Products & Specialty Ingredients for Manufacturers
* [ Personal Care & Cosmetics ][35]
* [ Coatings, Adhesives, Elastomers & Sealants ][36]
* [ Household, Industrial & Institutional Cleaning ][37]
* [ Lubricants, Greases & Metalworking Fluids ][38]
* [ Life Sciences ][39]

[Natural and organic skin care and beauty products.]

## A Culture of Accountability

For everyone at Acme-Hardesty, it’s about more than simply what we do, it’s about why we do it. We
are driven by **[strong cultural beliefs][40]** and the value-based principles of integrity and
respect.

[respectful relationships icon]

## Our Role in the Manufacturing Process

We see ourselves as a bridge that connects suppliers to consumers and provides essential
[oleochemicals][42] and materials manufacturers need to create superior products to make life better
for millions of consumers worldwide. We also **[work with the best suppliers][43]** to ensure our
customers are fully supported at all times.

Since 1942, Acme-Hardesty has served as **[a leading distributor][44]** of castor and palm oils and
derivatives. We provide innovative bio-based products and solutions for industrial and regulated
markets, maintain preferred relationships with suppliers and exceed customer expectations with
optimized logistics. Plus, our attention to detail is unmatched and allows us to manage risk
consistently.

[Learn More][45]

## Why **Responsible Manufacturers** Rely on Acme-Hardesty for High-Quality Sustainable Ingredients

At Acme-Hardesty, our word is our bond. We **[prioritize sustainability][33]** in the bio-based
chemical sourcing industry and provide renewable, sustainable alternatives for manufacturers.

Acme-Hardesty understands **[relationships matter][34]**, and no one in this business does it alone.
Our relationships are built on trust, innovation and sustainable performance. We call upon our
deeply valued relationships to meet the needs of suppliers and customers as well as provide a
dependable, cost-effective flow of quality products from source to end user.

## Our Suite of Bio-Based Products & Specialty Ingredients for Manufacturers
* [ Personal Care & Cosmetics ][35]
* [ Coatings, Adhesives, Elastomers & Sealants ][36]
* [ Household, Industrial & Institutional Cleaning ][37]
* [ Lubricants, Greases & Metalworking Fluids ][38]
* [ Life Sciences ][39]

[Natural and organic skin care and beauty products.]

## A Culture of Accountability

For everyone at Acme-Hardesty, it’s about more than simply what we do, it’s about why we do it. We
are driven by **[strong cultural beliefs][40]** and the value-based principles of integrity and
respect.

## Our Role in the Manufacturing Process

We see ourselves as a bridge that connects suppliers to consumers and provides essential
[oleochemicals][42] and materials manufacturers need to create superior products to make life better
for millions of consumers worldwide. We also **[work with the best suppliers][43]** to ensure our
customers are fully supported at all times.

Since 1942, Acme-Hardesty has served as **[a leading distributor][44]** of castor and palm oils and
derivatives. We provide innovative bio-based products and solutions for industrial and regulated
markets, maintain preferred relationships with suppliers and exceed customer expectations with
optimized logistics. Plus, our attention to detail is unmatched and allows us to manage risk
consistently.

### Your chemical needs
### Our chemical solutions

At Aktopa, the only thing more important than our chemicals are our customers.
It’s a simple mindset that yields extraordinary results.

##### [Watch Video][26]

### seamless
### from start to finish


Aktopa is engineered to deliver chemical solutions tailored to your needs.

As global industries continue to grow in size and technology, so do their chemical needs. The
bottleneck to their growth? Not having an international sourcing network that can provide adaptable,
real-time transportation logistics with unrivaled customer service. How do they get past this
bottleneck?

#### By Choosing Aktopa.

We coordinate the logistics to deliver the chemical products you need, when and how you need them.
Our success is founded on strong, dedicated relationships with suppliers and transporters who — like
us — raise the bar for customer satisfaction, while meeting the world's growing demand for chemical
products.

#### International Relationships

With a sourcing network that includes North America, Europe, and Asia, and extensive experience
serving clients in both Mexico and the United States, Aktopa has established international
relationships to break down transborder barriers and fill chemical market gaps in these regions of
specialty and more.

#### Investing in Our Customers

Our business isn’t just about chemicals. It’s about relationships. At Aktopa, we exhaust every
resource to ensure clients get the greatest value, not only from our chemical products but also from
our service. Through flexible financing options, transparent communication, and more, our goal is to
add value to our clients’ supply chain.

#### INDUSTRY DIVERSITY

With a 20-year history in the chemical market, Aktopa offers a broad portfolio of chemicals that
meet TDS and SDS specifications. Glycol ethers, aliphatic solvents, base oils, water treatment
chemicals, inorganics, polymers, and more – our current and new product inventory can service a wide
array of supply chains.

#### INNOVATION

We go beyond the status quo. We continuously learn about and integrate new technologies and products
to meet the evolving demands of our clients and our global economy. Because real solutions that meet
your real needs require creativity and commitment. That’s why Aktopa is a vital supply chain
resource for many of its customers.

#### Monochlorobenzene

### MCB

Aktopa can promptly provide this versatile aromatic halogen for customers that use it as an
intermediate in making organic chemicals – from agricultural pesticides to dyes and perfumes – or as
a reaction carrier solvent in the process of making MDI.

REQUEST A QUOTE

#### Dicyclopentadiene

### DCPD

Used in plastics and synthetic resins, agriculture, flavor, and fragrance markets, Aktopa is ready
to provide this raw material for diverse, fine chemical product supply chains.

REQUEST A QUOTE


### TUNG OIL

Let Aktopa meet your supply chain’s need for Tung oil – a finishing product with excellent alkali
and chemical protection qualities that provides a tough, flexible, and high water-resistant coating.

REQUEST A QUOTE

### Your chemical needs
### Our chemical solutions

At Aktopa, the only thing more important than our chemicals are our customers.
It’s a simple mindset that yields extraordinary results.

##### [Watch Video][26]

### seamless
### from start to finish


Aktopa is engineered to deliver chemical solutions tailored to your needs.

As global industries continue to grow in size and technology, so do their chemical needs. The
bottleneck to their growth? Not having an international sourcing network that can provide adaptable,
real-time transportation logistics with unrivaled customer service. How do they get past this
bottleneck?

#### By Choosing Aktopa.

We coordinate the logistics to deliver the chemical products you need, when and how you need them.
Our success is founded on strong, dedicated relationships with suppliers and transporters who — like
us — raise the bar for customer satisfaction, while meeting the world's growing demand for chemical
products.

#### International Relationships

With a sourcing network that includes North America, Europe, and Asia, and extensive experience
serving clients in both Mexico and the United States, Aktopa has established international
relationships to break down transborder barriers and fill chemical market gaps in these regions of
specialty and more.

#### Investing in Our Customers

Our business isn’t just about chemicals. It’s about relationships. At Aktopa, we exhaust every
resource to ensure clients get the greatest value, not only from our chemical products but also from
our service. Through flexible financing options, transparent communication, and more, our goal is to
add value to our clients’ supply chain.

#### INDUSTRY DIVERSITY

With a 20-year history in the chemical market, Aktopa offers a broad portfolio of chemicals that
meet TDS and SDS specifications. Glycol ethers, aliphatic solvents, base oils, water treatment
chemicals, inorganics, polymers, and more – our current and new product inventory can service a wide
array of supply chains.

#### INNOVATION

We go beyond the status quo. We continuously learn about and integrate new technologies and products
to meet the evolving demands of our clients and our global economy. Because real solutions that meet
your real needs require creativity and commitment. That’s why Aktopa is a vital supply chain
resource for many of its customers.

#### Monochlorobenzene

### MCB

Aktopa can promptly provide this versatile aromatic halogen for customers that use it as an
intermediate in making organic chemicals – from agricultural pesticides to dyes and perfumes – or as
a reaction carrier solvent in the process of making MDI.

REQUEST A QUOTE

#### Dicyclopentadiene

### DCPD

Used in plastics and synthetic resins, agriculture, flavor, and fragrance markets, Aktopa is ready
to provide this raw material for diverse, fine chemical product supply chains.

REQUEST A QUOTE


### TUNG OIL

Let Aktopa meet your supply chain’s need for Tung oil – a finishing product with excellent alkali
and chemical protection qualities that provides a tough, flexible, and high water-resistant coating.

REQUEST A QUOTE

# An ever-expanding

[logo-bg-large]
[A global leader in the essential oils and aromatic chemicals industry]

### A global leader in the essential oils and aromatic chemicals industry

Berjé’s commitment to stability and consistency in flavor and fragrance ingredients has fostered
long-term partnerships in over 100 sourcing locations. Combined with our supply chain expertise,
this ensures unmatched reliability in a constantly evolving market.

[ About Berjé ][22]

## Our products

Essential Oils

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

Upcycled Ingredients

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

#### Natural Aromatics

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

[farm-e1761900668825.jpg]

Aromatic Chemicals

#### Aromatic Chemicals

Flavors and fragrances stem from the art of chemistry. To complement our essential oils, Berjé
offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

## The [berje logo] promise

# Leading the Evolution of Speciality Oleo Chemicals

Fairchem leads the Indian speciality chemicals industry as one of the established Chemical Companies
in India and a trusted [Oleochemicals][14] Company in India. As a quality-driven Chemical
Manufacturing Company, we procure and refine by-products from vegetable oil refineries into valuable
ingredients used across high-value applications.

Recognized among progressive Specialty Chemical Companies in India, Fairchem contributes
significantly to the growing Oleochemical Industry in India by manufacturing performance-driven
Oleochemicals Products for nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial segments.

## About US

## Unveiling Fairchem

At Fairchem Organics Limited, we have built a dedicated platform to capitalize on the immense
opportunities within the Indian specialty chemical sector. Today, we are recognized among
progressive Chemical Companies in India and emerging leaders within the Oleochemical Industry in
India.

Our journey began with a vision to transform the industry, and today we stand as a trusted Chemical
Manufacturing Company delivering sustainable and value-driven solutions across industries.

[ Discover Our Impact ][15]

We have perfected a unique business model that revolves around procuring waste generated in
vegetable oil refining mills and converting it into high-value specialty ingredients. Through
advanced process technologies and operational excellence, we isolate and purify various components
that form the foundation of performance-driven Oleochemicals Products.

These include Isostearic Acid, Dimer Acid, Dimer Fatty Acid, and other specialty derivatives,
positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid
Manufacturers in India. Our products serve diverse applications ranging from paints and coatings to
printing inks and industrial formulations.

Explore our journey, innovation capabilities, and commitment to shaping the future of specialty
chemicals in India.

## Explore Our Product Range

Explore our range of high-quality Oleochemicals Products and [nutraceutical][16] ingredients,
meticulously crafted for diverse industries. As one of the trusted Chemical Manufacturing Companies
in India, we deliver performance-driven solutions that support the growing Oleochemical Industry in
India and modern Nutraceuticals Manufacturing requirements.

Our commitment to excellence sets out the benchmark for innovation, sustainability, and product
reliability across specialty segments.

[ Discover Product ][17]

## Nutraceuticals

### The Power of Tocopherols

Our Mixed Tocopherols are a natural source of Vitamin E, a potent antioxidant known to support
wellness and slow down oxidative stress. As one of the trusted Tocopherol Manufacturers in India, we
specialize in producing high-quality Natural Vitamin E ingredients for diverse applications.

Recognized among reliable Natural Vitamin E Manufacturers and experienced Vitamin E Manufacturers in
India, Fairchem supplies refined tocopherol concentrates to global nutraceutical and wellness
brands. Our expertise in Nutraceuticals Manufacturing ensures consistent purity, stability, and
performance across formulations.

As dependable Tocopherol Suppliers and a quality-driven Vitamin E Oil Manufacturer in India, we
support customers with sustainable, traceable, and regulatory-compliant solutions designed to
enhance health-focused product development.

[ Learn More ][18]
[Tocopherol Manufacturer]

## Oleochemicals

### Transforming Fatty Acids

Unlock the potential of long-chain Fatty Acids with our high-grade Dimer Acid and specialty
derivatives. As a leading Oleochemicals Company in India, Fairchem transforms by-products of
vegetable oil refining into performance-driven Oleochemicals Products that support multiple
industries.

Derived from acid oil, our solutions include Dimer Fatty Acid, Isostearic Acid, and other specialty
materials, positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid
Manufacturers in India. Our products serve applications across coatings, adhesives, inks,
lubricants, and industrial formulations.

Recognized within the evolving Oleochemical Industry in India, we are also dependable Fatty Acid
Suppliers in India, delivering consistent quality, regulatory compliance, and sustainable sourcing
to global markets.

[ Discover More ][19]
[Fatty Acid]

## our certifications

Our certifications reflect our commitment to quality, sustainability, and global compliance. With
ISO, REACH, Halal, and Kosher approvals, Fairchem ensures trusted and responsible manufacturing
standards.
* ISO 9001:   2015 (Quality Management)
* ISO 14001: 2015 (Environmental Management

### Sustainability

#### Largely, in Australia, plant pots and labels are made from PP5 plastic – a plastic that can be
#### recycled over and over again. However, currently only 8% of this plastic found in plant pots is
#### recycled.

GCP’s collection service is available free for customers in most areas. Additionally, PP5 drop off
points can be found in over 30 locations Australia wide at participating suppliers and retailers.

Once your PP5 plastic waste is collected and recycled, GCP, with industry leaders Norwood printers,

### Sustainability

#### Largely, in Australia, plant pots and labels are made from PP5 plastic – a plastic that can be
#### recycled over and over again. However, currently only 8% of this plastic found in plant pots is
#### recycled.

GCP’s collection service is available free for customers in most areas. Additionally, PP5 drop off
points can be found in over 30 locations Australia wide at participating suppliers and retailers.

Once your PP5 plastic waste is collected and recycled, GCP, with industry leaders Norwood printers,
create new products out of the recycled material – turning old, discarded products into new one’s.

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

  #### The Bioengineering of Cellular Recovery: Optimizing Human Performance Through Controlled
  #### Atmospheric
  
  The Bioengineering of Cellular Recovery: Optimizing Human Performance Through Controlled
  Atmospheric Environments
  
  # [1752023938183-20250730014253-转换自-webp.png]
  
  The advent of the [micro oxygen chamber][33] has fundamentally shifted how bioengineers and
  physiologists approach tissue recovery, athletic performance, and cellular regeneration. In the
  realm of biomechanics and human performance optimization, the physical exertion placed on muscles
  and joints requires highly efficient metabolic clearance and tissue repair mechanisms. By strictly
  controlling atmospheric pressure and oxygen concentration, modern bioengineering allows us to
  manipulate hemodynamics at a cellular level, delivering targeted respiratory support exactly where
  damaged tissues need it most.
  
  ## The Physiology of Pressurized Oxygen Therapy
  
  Human movement and intensive physical therapy heavily rely on adenosine triphosphate (ATP)
  production. When the body undergoes rigorous biomechanical stress, oxygen demand skyrockets, often
  leading to a hypoxic state in localized muscle tissues and the rapid accumulation of lactic acid.
  By increasing the partial pressure of oxygen in the blood plasma—a principle dictated by Henry's
  Law of gas solubility—engineered atmospheric environments force higher volumes of life-sustaining
  oxygen to dissolve directly into the bloodstream. This physiological mechanism bypasses the
  standard limitations of red blood cell transport, allowing oxygen to reach deep tissues, reduce
  dangerous inflammation, and dramatically accelerate the healing of micro-tears in muscle fibers.
  
  ## Behind the Hardware: Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) Technology
  
  Creating these hyper-optimized recovery environments is no small feat of engineering. The backbone
  of any clinical-grade atmospheric system is its gas separation technology. Advanced systems
  utilize Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) technology paired with sophisticated zeolite molecular
  sieves. These materials act as microscopic filters, selectively trapping nitrogen molecules from
  ambient air while allowing oxygen to pass through, consistently yielding oxygen concentrations
  between 93% and 95%.
  
  The reliability of this process dictates the clinical efficacy of the therapy. Therefore, modern
  rehabilitation facilities and bioengineering research centers rely heavily on advanced suppliers
  and high-quality providers capable of integrating soundless compressors, precise digital pressure
  monitors, and medical-grade air purification protocols into a single, cohesive unit. These premium
  manufacturing standards ensure that the equipment not only meets CE certifications but operates
  continuously with minimal acoustic disruption (often under 60dB) and zero safety risks associated
  with traditional high-pressure oxygen cylinders.
  
  ## Standardizing Parameters: The Role of Mild Hyperbaric Environments
  
  In bioengineering research regarding athletic recovery and geriatric microcirculation, finding the
  optimal pressure parameter is critical. Pushing pressure too high can introduce oxygen toxicity
  risks, while too low yields negligible benefits. When evaluating structural and systemic recovery
  hardware, standardizing around a [1.0 ata oxygen chamber][34] provides a highly controlled, safe
  baseline for mild atmospheric therapy. Operating around 1.0 to 1.3 ATA (Atmospheres Absolute)
  ensures consistent oxygen saturation that promotes collagen production, accelerates post-surgical
  wound healing, and enhances cognitive focus through cerebral oxygenation, all without subjecting
  the patient to the extreme barotrauma risks of deep-sea level pressurization.
  
  ## Conclusion: The Future of Biomechanical Support Systems
  
  As the intersection of bioengineering and holistic health continues to expand, the reliance on
  precision-engineered respiratory support systems will only grow. Moving away from finite,
  logistically cumbersome oxygen delivery methods toward continuous, on-site generation represents a
  massive leap in medical supply chain efficiency. By leveraging these advanced atmospheric
  technologies, researchers and clinicians can unlock new frontiers in human longevity, metabolic
  recovery, and overall biomechanical resilience.

  #### The Bioengineering of Cellular Recovery: Optimizing Human Performance Through Controlled

  The Bioengineering of Cellular Recovery: Optimizing Human Performance Through Controlled
  Atmospheric Environments
  
  # [1752023938183-20250730014253-转换自-webp.png]
  
  The advent of the [micro oxygen chamber][33] has fundamentally shifted how bioengineers and
  physiologists approach tissue recovery, athletic performance, and cellular regeneration. In the
  realm of biomechanics and human performance optimization, the physical exertion placed on muscles
  and joints requires highly efficient metabolic clearance and tissue repair mechanisms. By strictly
  controlling atmospheric pressure and oxygen concentration, modern bioengineering allows us to
  manipulate hemodynamics at a cellular level, delivering targeted respiratory support exactly where
  damaged tissues need it most.
  
  ## The Physiology of Pressurized Oxygen Therapy
  
  Human movement and intensive physical therapy heavily rely on adenosine triphosphate (ATP)
  production. When the body undergoes rigorous biomechanical stress, oxygen demand skyrockets, often
  leading to a hypoxic state in localized muscle tissues and the rapid accumulation of lactic acid.
  By increasing the partial pressure of oxygen in the blood plasma—a principle dictated by Henry's
  Law of gas solubility—engineered atmospheric environments force higher volumes of life-sustaining
  oxygen to dissolve directly into the bloodstream. This physiological mechanism bypasses the
  standard limitations of red blood cell transport, allowing oxygen to reach deep tissues, reduce
  dangerous inflammation, and dramatically accelerate the healing of micro-tears in muscle fibers.
  
  ## Behind the Hardware: Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) Technology
  
  Creating these hyper-optimized recovery environments is no small feat of engineering. The backbone
  of any clinical-grade atmospheric system is its gas separation technology. Advanced systems
  utilize Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) technology paired with sophisticated zeolite molecular
  sieves. These materials act as microscopic filters, selectively trapping nitrogen molecules from
  ambient air while allowing oxygen to pass through, consistently yielding oxygen concentrations
  between 93% and 95%.
  
  The reliability of this process dictates the clinical efficacy of the therapy. Therefore, modern
  rehabilitation facilities and bioengineering research centers rely heavily on advanced suppliers
  and high-quality providers capable of integrating soundless compressors, precise digital pressure
  monitors, and medical-grade air purification protocols into a single, cohesive unit. These premium
  manufacturing standards ensure that the equipment not only meets CE certifications but operates
  continuously with minimal acoustic disruption (often under 60dB) and zero safety risks associated
  with traditional high-pressure oxygen cylinders.
  
  ## Standardizing Parameters: The Role of Mild Hyperbaric Environments
  
  In bioengineering research regarding athletic recovery and geriatric microcirculation, finding the
  optimal pressure parameter is critical. Pushing pressure too high can introduce oxygen toxicity
  risks, while too low yields negligible benefits. When evaluating structural and systemic recovery
  hardware, standardizing around a [1.0 ata oxygen chamber][34] provides a highly controlled, safe
  baseline for mild atmospheric therapy. Operating around 1.0 to 1.3 ATA (Atmospheres Absolute)
  ensures consistent oxygen saturation that promotes collagen production, accelerates post-surgical
  wound healing, and enhances cognitive focus through cerebral oxygenation, all without subjecting
  the patient to the extreme barotrauma risks of deep-sea level pressurization.
  
  ## Conclusion: The Future of Biomechanical Support Systems
  
  As the intersection of bioengineering and holistic health continues to expand, the reliance on
  precision-engineered respiratory support systems will only grow. Moving away from finite,
  logistically cumbersome oxygen delivery methods toward continuous, on-site generation represents a
  massive leap in medical supply chain efficiency. By leveraging these advanced atmospheric
  technologies, researchers and clinicians can unlock new frontiers in human longevity, metabolic
  recovery, and overall biomechanical resilience.

Malaysia and Indonesia, as well as the preference for vegetable-based oleochemicals in numerous
industries.

international markets. We are now able to supply the United States, Europe, Africa, the Middle East,
and other nations with high-quality Soap Noodles, Palm Oil, Amides And Betaine, Vegetable Fats,

We have partnerships with important sourcing and supply markets in Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand
that create a variety of premium sustainable oleochemicals made from feedstock derived from
vegetables. Our product line includes fatty alcohols, fatty esters, basic fatty acids, and
glycerine. Numerous end-use applications make use of our products.

Green chemicals, sustainable development, and environmental friendliness are the new priorities of
modern society.

MSD Global has had notable expansion. This was made possible by competent management at every level
of our organization, dependable relationships with our manufacturers, andabove allour ability to
handle large volumes of business and provide our clients with high-quality materials. We are
concentrating on new downstream business, supported by a strong confidence in innovation and
thorough market research.

**Vision and Mission**

* **Customer Centric- **To be a leading trading company in Palm & palm kernel oils and their
  derivatives. To keep abreast of technological developments in the fats & oils production and
  related fields
* **Credibility & Integrity- **We maintain honesty, trustworthiness, and high ethical standards. We
  will continue serving our customers better by setting high standards for our products and people.

  customers and manufacturers.
* **Leader-** To be one of the leading trading companies in Palm & palm kernel oils and their

  business process. Fresh creative ideas that result in an extended range of products and solutions
  with added value serve as one stop solutions and provide a strong competitive edge for the success
  of our customer and clients.
* **Team Work- **We work as a team to achieve our corporate goal.

**Our Pillars Of Our Success

Reliable Services**

Reliable supply of high-quality goods. Effective worldwide distribution and network supply made
possible by an internal operations and logistics team, as well as extensive customer and product
support. Our logistics and distribution network is extensive. Logistics: We have a dedicated
logistics and operations team that can manage the transportation of huge quantities of containers as
part of our distribution capabilities. Additionally, we have partnerships with the biggest and most
reputable international logistics firms, which enable us to transport materials around the world
with ease.

**Manufacturers**

We aim for greatness. At the core of our business are highly automated, ISO and GMP certified
factories with state-of-the-art facilities that have been thoughtfully designed and built with
functionality in mind. To guarantee quality and worldwide supply continuity, we meticulously oversee
every step of the production, packaging, and logistics planning processes. Modern development labs
run by our manufacturers offer services for testing, product development, and custom formulations.
Our producers are prepared to create innovative goods or enhance the qualities of their current
models. At the heart of all we do is innovation.

**Market Research & Analysis**

We have a unique real-time insight of industry trends because to our extensive client base and
market research department. Understanding the markets they serve and the clients they represent is
the first step in developing a successful marketing plan. With a worldwide viewpoint, MSD worldwide
monitors daily palm oil prices and market trends. To create a comprehensive picture of competition
pricing and product offering, we support our observations with the viewpoints of industry experts.

**Product Positioning**

We are aware of product life cycles and how they relate to consumer needs. We may customize product
qualities based on customer preferences by using a wide variety of oleochemicals.

**Analytical Labs**

MSD worldwide manufacturers follow GMP/FDA guidelines while maintaining testing procedures and
documentation. Moisture, free fatty acid/free alkaline, salt, and active ingredient testing are all
ongoing oleochemical assays.

Testing methods:

* Liquid Chromatographs
* Uv Visible Spectrometer
* Karl Fisher Auto Titrators

Our company always places a high premium on quality assurance, and we take great satisfaction in our
relationships with top manufacturers who adhere to strict QC guidelines. Every production facility
has the most recent standard operating procedure in place and is routinely audited. MSD Global
offers a distinct perspective on specialty fats and oleochemicals. We attain unheard-of control over
our manufacturing by integrating our manufacturer's expertise with the newest systems and
cutting-edge technologies. Our manufacturer's quality advantage is a result of comprehensive testing
of incoming feedstock, computerized process modeling, state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment, and
diligent employees. Our top-tier quality processes are acknowledged by our esteemed clients
worldwide.

# the OLIVE OIL SOURCE

The Olive Oil Source strives to be and is recognized internationally as the most comprehensive
resource for products, trends, and information on everything related to olive oil. Whether you are a
producer seeking information on the latest equipment, a retailer of olive oil related products, or
an olive oil lover, our goal is to have “Everything but the Olive” available for you. The Olive Oil
Source website was originally developed to provide information about olive oil. Adding products for
sale, and eventually an on-line store came as a natural development as visitors asked us to help
them find various items.

Everything but the Olive

# the OLIVE OIL SOURCE

The Olive Oil Source strives to be and is recognized internationally as the most comprehensive
resource for products, trends, and information on everything related to olive oil. Whether you are a
producer seeking information on the latest equipment, a retailer of olive oil related products, or
an olive oil lover, our goal is to have “Everything but the Olive” available for you. The Olive Oil
Source website was originally developed to provide information about olive oil. Adding products for
sale, and eventually an on-line store came as a natural development as visitors asked us to help
them find various items.

[Olive Facts and Definitions]

We are in the unique position of having personal experience with growing olives and maintaining an
organic orchard, making olive oil, packaging and marketing it, and running a business. This allows
us to provide our customers with products and information based on actual field experience. We pride
ourselves on trying to help our customers be as successful as they can be rather than just sell them
something. We strive to give them the best possible advice whether they want to buy a line of olive
oil and vinegar products, a gift for a friend, find original wedding or party favors, buy equipment
for their orchard or buy a complete line of commercial milling equipment. Please let us know if
there is anything you did not find and that you would like us to help you with.

## **Why Choose the OU**

**Reach more consumers worldwide**
For 100 years the OU symbol has been the most recognized kosher mark.  Its promoted through our
global programs, social media, apps, and websites.

**Get help navigating the supply chain**
Access manufacturers worldwide through the largest kosher ingredients database and get help finding
approved ingredients and co-packers

**Build trust with retailers and brands**
Major retailers and global food companies rely on the OU symbol, backed by our detailed review of
ingredients, processes, and labels.

[More on Why the OU][174]

## **What is Kosher?**

You may already be familiar with some of the more well-known requirements, but you may be surprised
at the extent of some regulations. Kosher is a comprehensive system of food standards rooted in
Jewish law that governs not only ingredients, but also how food is prepared, processed, and handled.

Under trusted certification such as OU Kosher, every step of production is carefully reviewed, from
raw materials to equipment and facilities. This level of oversight helps ensure consistency,
integrity, and trust, giving consumers greater confidence in the products they choose.

## **Why Choose the OU**

**Reach more consumers worldwide**
For 100 years the OU symbol has been the most recognized kosher mark.  Its promoted through our
global programs, social media, apps, and websites.

**Get help navigating the supply chain**

**Build trust with retailers and brands**
Major retailers and global food companies rely on the OU symbol, backed by our detailed review of
ingredients, processes, and labels.

[More on Why the OU][174]

## **What is Kosher?**

You may already be familiar with some of the more well-known requirements, but you may be surprised
at the extent of some regulations. Kosher is a comprehensive system of food standards rooted in
Jewish law that governs not only ingredients, but also how food is prepared, processed, and handled.

Under trusted certification such as OU Kosher, every step of production is carefully reviewed, from
raw materials to equipment and facilities. This level of oversight helps ensure consistency,
integrity, and trust, giving consumers greater confidence in the products they choose.

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

## **Renamax 92 & 98** Azelaic Acid

Our innovative production process achieves various levels of purity; a feature that is extremely
important in its use in all kinds of formulations. Azelaic Acid has some unique properties. 

This ranges from the melting behaviour in high molecular weight plastics and resins, to superior low
temperature characteristics of plasticizers for PVC and other polymers, as well as synthetic
lubricant ester base fluids. [Read more >][22] 

[medical-reagents]

## ** Renalin **Pelargonic Acid

n-Nonanoic acid, commonly known as pelargonic acid, is a mono-carboxylic acid with a linear chain
comprising of nine Carbon atoms. Through the odd-numbered Carbon chain: pelargonic acid derivatives

## Global Resources. Local Solutions

****

As a distributor, importer, and trader of commodity chemicals, our mission is simple: provide
customers with reliable supply, market expertise, and exceptional service regardless of market
conditions. 

We take pride in maintaining a robust global supply portfolio supported by multiple domestic and
international sourcing relationships, supply redundancies, and contingency plans. In an increasingly
dynamic world, our customers rely on us to navigate supply chain disruptions and deliver consistent
results.

At the same time, we recognize that global supply is only part of the equation. Through
strategically positioned inventory across **20 stocking locations throughout the United States and

that allow our customers to receive product when and where they need it.

**. **


 


## Service is our specialty.

****

Our business is intentionally focused on a narrow product portfolio, with **oleochemicals
representing more than 90% of our business**. This disciplined approach allows us to develop deep
expertise in both the products we sell and the markets we serve. Rather than being generalists, we
strive to be trusted specialists and market experts.

Our goal is not simply to execute transactions. We seek to be a valued partner—helping customers
understand market dynamics, navigate volatility, manage risk, and make informed sourcing decisions.
We believe the strongest relationships are built through knowledge, trust, and consistent
execution.********

**Glycerine is our largest product category**, and we are proud to be one of the largest glycerine
marketers in North America. We actively participate across virtually every grade, specification, and
feedstock source, including both domestic and imported supply. In addition, we maintain a
significant presence in **distilled and fractionated fatty acids, fatty alcohols, and related
oleochemical products**, serving a diverse range of industrial and consumer markets.

At Rierden Chemical & Trading, we combine global market reach, deep product expertise, and local
execution to help our customers succeed—today and for the long term.

## Find. Vet. Source.

SC CHEM is a family-owned, sourcing-first distribution partner that helps companies secure complex
and hard-to-find chemicals through a single, end-to-end process. By combining global supplier
networks with hands-on expertise, we simplify sourcing while delivering the personal service you
expect from a boutique partner.

## A Family-Owned Partner with Global Reach

As a family-owned company based in the United States, SC CHEM brings decades of global sourcing
experience to every engagement. Our clients benefit from deep industry knowledge, trusted supplier
relationships, and a highly personalized approach that allows us to move quickly and solve complex
sourcing challenges. 

[VIEW OUR PRODUCTS][42]
[SC CHEM Team Photo Original 2025.jpg]
[Chemical Treatment Plant stock image.jpg]

## One Stop, One Partner

Our trusted global network of chemical manufacturers and technical partners allows SC CHEM to source
even the most challenging materials. Tell us what you need, and we’ll take care of identifying,
vetting, and coordinating the right solution. If a material can’t be sourced, we work with qualified
partners to have it made and delivered to your specifications.

[VIEW SERVICES ][43]

## Our Story

Founded by industry expert Frank Fisher, SC CHEM is built on decades of global importing, sourcing,
and supplier relationship experience. That foundation drives our commitment to transparency, trust,
and solving complex sourcing challenges for our clients. 

[MORE ABOUT SC CHEM ][44]

[Jordan Fisher Presentation.jpg]

developments.

## About Us

Committed to achieve Qualitative Growth of Clients, Shiv Shakti Group has become a well-known name
in the Indian disinfectant industry. With exports, the Group has already begun its journey towards
becoming a global firm. Started with trading of disinfectant **raw materials** under the banner of
Shiv Shakti Trading Corporation, today, after 15 years, our portfolio has expanded to meet varied
industry demands. Shiv Shakti India, the manufacturing arm of the Group, produces various raw
materials, including Phenolic Products, Benzalkonium Chloride, Chlorinated Xylenols, Glycols,
Quaternary Compounds, and Aldehyde-based Biocides. These serve industries such as auxiliary
chemicals, construction chemicals, disinfectant chemicals, distilled industrial and cleaning
solvents, leather chemicals, preservatives, poultry chemicals, and water treatment chemicals.

We believe in supplying the right product with better service. Our commitment to quality raw
materials has made Shiv Shakti Group an industry leader. In 2013, we received ISO 9001:2008 and ISO
14001:2004 certification by UL DQS Inc for our Quality and Environmental Management System. Our
customer-oriented approach helps us gain more satisfied clients by giving them value for money.

We are committed to supplying the best quality raw materials on time. Located in Vadodara,
Gujaratone of Indias major industrial hubsour facility is well connected by rail, road, and air,
enabling efficient transport to all parts of India and to Mumbai Port for export. This ensures
timely delivery of raw materials to our clients.

## About Us

Committed to achieve Qualitative Growth of Clients, Shiv Shakti Group has become a well-known name
in the Indian disinfectant industry. With exports, the Group has already begun its journey towards
becoming a global firm. Started with trading of disinfectant **raw materials** under the banner of
Shiv Shakti Trading Corporation, today, after 15 years, our portfolio has expanded to meet varied
industry demands. Shiv Shakti India, the manufacturing arm of the Group, produces various raw
materials, including Phenolic Products, Benzalkonium Chloride, Chlorinated Xylenols, Glycols,
Quaternary Compounds, and Aldehyde-based Biocides. These serve industries such as auxiliary
chemicals, construction chemicals, disinfectant chemicals, distilled industrial and cleaning
solvents, leather chemicals, preservatives, poultry chemicals, and water treatment chemicals.

We believe in supplying the right product with better service. Our commitment to quality raw
materials has made Shiv Shakti Group an industry leader. In 2013, we received ISO 9001:2008 and ISO
14001:2004 certification by UL DQS Inc for our Quality and Environmental Management System. Our
customer-oriented approach helps us gain more satisfied clients by giving them value for money.

We are committed to supplying the best quality raw materials on time. Located in Vadodara,
Gujaratone of Indias major industrial hubsour facility is well connected by rail, road, and air,
enabling efficient transport to all parts of India and to Mumbai Port for export. This ensures
timely delivery of raw materials to our clients.
